title: Diffusive flux into a stochastically gated tube
summary: Diffusion-influenced reactions in the presence of gates which randomly open and close have been studied for decades in a variety of biophysical and biochemical scenarios. The diffusive flux from a large bulk reservoir to the end of a narrow tube with a stochastically gated entrance has been previously estimated. In this paper, we extend this gated flux estimate to be valid if (i) the tube is not necessarily narrow and/or (ii) the diffusivity differs in the tube versus the bulk.
